prompts.Golem: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG sprite sheet for a polished top-down 2D roguelike boss. Create ONE horizontal sheet with exactly THREE equally sized square cells, no gutters, depicting three phases of the SAME original stone golem boss. Each character centered in its cell with identical ground contact and scale, all limbs fully contained with generous transparent margins. Camera three-quarter overhead facing down toward viewer, full body. Sophisticated hand painted pixel-art game sprite, crisp readable silhouette and restrained detail, heavy dark outline. Phase 1 left: imposing slate-blue stone titan, asymmetric massive armored fists, ancient bronze bands, small amber core. Phase 2 middle: broken shoulder plates, larger jagged fists and bright orange fissures, aggressive forward stance. Phase 3 right: molten amber core exposed, obsidian armor splitting into angular floating shoulder slabs, looming powerful silhouette. Must look dangerous and handsome, never cute, no square placeholder look. Transparent background with real alpha; no ground, no cast shadow, no scenery, no text, no labels, no grid, no border. Keep glow confined close to body, no large opaque effects. Output landscape 3:1 sheet intended to slice at exact one-third widths.
prompts.Spider: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE transparent PNG horizontal 3:1 sprite sheet, THREE equally sized square cells with three phases of SAME original boss for top-down 2D roguelike. Full body centered individually with identical scale and generous padding inside each exact one-third-width cell. Camera three-quarter overhead facing viewer. Polished hand-painted game art with crisp dark outlines, strong readable silhouette at 160px, restrained detail. Real transparent alpha background, no ground, no text, no borders, no labels, no grid, no scenery. All limbs fully inside each cell, no inter-cell overlap. Glow confined close to body. An intimidating armored giant spider, eight sharply articulated legs, regal black-violet chitin with jade poison sacs, narrow red eyes, no human features. Left phase1: compact armored carapace, legs poised. Middle phase2: outer carapace split revealing green luminous venom channels, longer aggressive raised forelegs. Right phase3: thorned crown of chitin, huge glowing jade abdomen and blade-like forelegs, threatening upright attack stance. Not cute, not a simple rounded blob.
